nodes.name: ApprovalFlowEngine
nodes.summary: V3 系统级通用审批流程引擎，支持审批流程匹配、启动、审批/拒绝操作，集成 MultiLevelApprovalService 实现多级审批，通过 ApprovalFlowConfigRepository 进行数据持久化

nodes.name: matchFlow
nodes.signature: async matchFlow(capabilityId: string, environment: string, riskLevel: number, tenantId: string = 'default'): Promise<ApprovalFlowConfig | null>
nodes.summary: 根据 capabilityId、environment、riskLevel 匹配最合适的审批流程配置，优先从缓存读取，否则从 Repository 查询

nodes.name: startFlow
nodes.signature: async startFlow(config: ApprovalFlowConfig, context: FlowStartContext, tenantId: string = 'default'): Promise<ApprovalResult>
nodes.summary: 根据匹配的流程配置创建审批请求，解析第一个节点的审批人并构建审批级别，通过 MultiLevelApprovalService 提交审批

nodes.name: approve
nodes.signature: async approve(ticketId: string, approverId: string, decision: 'approve' | 'reject', comment?: string): Promise<ApprovalResult>
nodes.summary: 对审批工单进行批准或拒绝操作，委托给 MultiLevelApprovalService 处理

nodes.name: reject
nodes.signature: async reject(ticketId: string, approverId: string, reason?: string): Promise<ApprovalResult>
nodes.summary: 拒绝操作的便捷包装方法，调用 approve 方法并传入 reject 决策

nodes.name: ApprovalTemplateService
nodes.summary: 审批模板管理服务，提供审批模板的创建、查询、删除功能，用于快速创建常见审批流程

nodes.name: createTemplate
nodes.signature: async createTemplate(tenantId: string, input: ApprovalTemplateInput): Promise<ApprovalTemplate>
nodes.summary: 创建审批模板，如果标记为默认模板则清除同资源类型的其他默认模板

nodes.name: ApprovalAgentPlugin
nodes.summary: Agent 插件接口，用于扩展审批系统的 AI 分析能力，包含评估、健康检查、风险分析、审批人建议、自动审批等可选方法

nodes.name: createDefaultAgentConfig
nodes.summary: 创建默认 Agent 配置，包含置信度阈值、低置信度处理方式、Agent 失败处理方式和超时设置

nodes.name: determineAutoAction
nodes.summary: 根据置信度和风险分判断自动动作，高置信度低风险自动批准，高置信度高风险自动拒绝，中等置信度转人工

nodes.name: MultiLevelApprovalService
nodes.summary: 多级审批工作流服务，支持多级串行/并行审批、审批链查询、待办列表等高级功能，基于 ApprovalRepository 进行数据持久化

nodes.name: submitApprovalRequest
nodes.signature: async submitApprovalRequest(tenantId: string, input: ApprovalRequestInput): Promise<ApprovalRequestDetail>
nodes.summary: 提交多级审批请求，创建审批实体和各级步骤，支持串行/并行模式

nodes.name: review
nodes.signature: async review(requestId: string, reviewerId: string, action: ApprovalAction, comment?: string): Promise<ApprovalRequestDetail>
nodes.summary: 审批操作（批准/拒绝），验证审批权限，更新步骤状态，判断是否通过或进入下一级

nodes.name: DefaultApprovalAgent
nodes.summary: 默认 AI 审批代理实现，整合规则引擎和 LLM 分析，支持风险分析、审批人建议、自动审批，AI 不可用时自动降级到规则模式

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: 评估审批决策，整合规则引擎和 LLM 分析，AI 不可用时降级到规则模式

nodes.name: TenantValidatorMiddleware
nodes.summary: API 层租户验证中间件，验证请求 Header 中的 tenant_id，检查是否与认证用户匹配，设置 TenantContext 供下游使用

nodes.name: getHandler
nodes.signature: getHandler(): (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply, done: HookHandlerDoneFunction) => Promise<void>
nodes.summary: 返回中间件处理函数，跳过特定路径，验证 tenant_id，设置请求级别的 TenantContext

nodes.name: TenantContext
nodes.summary: 租户上下文管理服务，从 JWT 或 Header 解析 tenant_id，设置 PostgreSQL session 变量，验证租户配额限制和资源访问权限

nodes.name: createTenantContext

tour.name: Platform Foundations
tour.description: Start here to understand the core infrastructure and tenant architecture that underpins the entire platform. This tour covers the underlying messaging, caching, and multi-tenancy foundations.

steps.description: Database connection and configuration - the foundation of all data operations in the platform.
Tenant context management - understand how multi-tenancy is maintained across requests.
Row Level Security policies - critical for data isolation between tenants.
API middleware for tenant validation - how incoming requests are validated and tenant context is established.
Core tenant management service - lifecycle and configuration of tenants.
Quota enforcement per tenant - resource limits and usage tracking.
Kubernetes namespace pool management - how tenants get isolated namespaces.
NATS service registry - distributed service discovery and messaging backbone.
Redis caching layer - performance optimization and session management.
Health check system - monitoring and readiness probes for the platform.

tour.name: Event-Driven Architecture
tour.description: Learn how the platform handles asynchronous communication, event streaming, and webhook integrations. Essential for understanding inter-service communication.

steps.description: JetStream manager - persistent messaging and stream management.
Event bus implementation - the central nervous system for domain events.
Webhook module exports and structure.
Webhook persistence layer - storing and retrieving webhook configurations.
Webhook delivery service - dispatching events to external subscribers with retry logic.

tour.name: Resource & Pipeline Management
tour.description: Explore how the platform manages compute resources, pipelines, and deployment budgets. This covers the core workflow orchestration capabilities.

steps.description: Resource abstraction layer - unified interface for managing compute resources across providers.
Maintenance window management - scheduling and enforcing operational blackout periods.
Pipeline budget enforcement - cost controls and resource allocation for CI/CD pipelines.
Kubernetes provisioning service - automated cluster and workload provisioning.
Agent execution service - running and managing automated tasks and workflows.
Ephemeral environment service - temporary environment lifecycle for testing and previews.

tour.name: Plugin & Extension System
tour.description: Understand the extensibility mechanisms that allow custom logic injection. Covers plugin management, execution, and task-type mapping.

steps.description: Task type to plugin mapping - routing tasks to appropriate plugin implementations.
Plugin manager - lifecycle management, registration, and discovery of plugins.
Plugin executor - sandboxed execution environment for running plugin code.

tour.name: Advanced Integrations
tour.description: Deep dive into specialized services for AI-powered security, CMDB integration, and agent profiles. These are advanced features that extend core platform capabilities.

steps.description: AI-powered security analysis - anomaly detection and threat assessment using machine learning.
CMDB integration - synchronizing with Configuration Management Databases for asset tracking.
Agent profile management - configuration and capabilities of automated agents.

tour.name: Cross-Domain Workflows
tour.description: Learn how complex cross-cutting concerns are orchestrated across multiple services and tenants. This is the highest-level business logic.

steps.description: Tenant module aggregation - how tenant-related services are composed together.
Cross-domain workflow repository - persistence and state management for complex multi-service workflows.

issues.message: Graph has only 10 edges for 72 nodes (edge-to-node ratio ~0.14), indicating severely missing relationships. A functional architecture knowledge graph should have significantly more connections representing dependencies, data flows, and interactions between modules.

No edges connecting modules across architectural layers. Critical dependencies such as TenantValidatorMiddleware (API/Middleware) → TenantService (Service Layer), or service modules → database.ts (Data Layer) are absent.

Service Layer modules likely depend on Infrastructure Layer components (nats-registry.ts, redis-cache.ts, event-bus-service.ts, jetstream-manager.ts), but these relationships are not represented in the graph.
Domain/Utility modules (TenantContext.ts, task-type-plugin-mapper.ts, webhook/index.ts, tenant/index.ts) should have incoming edges from dependent services, but these connections appear missing.

suggestions: Add dependency edges from API/Middleware to Service Layer: TenantValidatorMiddleware.ts → TenantService.ts

Add edges from Service Layer to Data/Repository Layer: MaintenanceWindowService.ts → CrossDomainWorkflowRepository.ts, agent-run-service.ts → database.ts, webhook/WebhookService.ts → webhook/WebhookRepository.ts
Add edges from Service Layer to Infrastructure Layer: event-bus-service.ts → nats-registry.ts, services → redis-cache.ts, services → database.ts
Add edges from Domain/Utility to Service Layer: TenantContext.ts → TenantService.ts, TenantQuotaService.ts, NamespacePoolService.ts
Add edges for tenant module relationships: TenantValidatorMiddleware.ts → TenantContext.ts, TenantService.ts → RLSPolicyManager.ts
Add plugin-related dependencies: task-type-plugin-mapper.ts → plugin-executor-service.ts, plugin-manager-service.ts → plugin-executor-service.ts
Add webhook module connections: webhook/index.ts → WebhookService.ts, WebhookService.ts → WebhookRepository.ts
Add edges for k8s and agent services: k8s-provisioner-service.ts → nats-registry.ts, agent-profile-service.ts → database.ts
Add edges representing ai-security.ts dependencies on relevant services and repositories
Target a minimum edge density of 0.5-1.0 edges per node (36-72 edges for 72 nodes) to capture meaningful architectural relationships
